confidence_notes: I ran five web searches: one for the RBA rate and four for Udaipur prices. Restaurant meal, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living pages (CityCost, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere, 360nations), which broadly agree on cheap local prices. Those pages are mostly in USD or older rupee figures. I used my own rough INR/USD rate of about 88-90 to read the rupee figures, and I did not search for that rate. The beer anchor is set above the cheap pub/bottle figures (about $1.5-2) to reflect restaurant and tourist-area pricing including taxes. Cocktail and wine rest on thin evidence: one undated hotel-restaurant menu (Frangipani by The Lake: about ₹425 per glass of wine and ₹500-700 per cocktail, before tax) and one Expatistan downtown-club cocktail point. I cross-checked those against the local price relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Udaipur's tourist market, not from booking pages or listings. They are the least certain anchors, especially hostel private rooms and 3-star rooms, which vary widely by season and lake proximity.
comparable_city_reasoning: Udaipur is a mid-sized Rajasthan tourist city. Its prices are comparable to Jaipur and Pushkar and slightly above non-tourist Indian cities, because lakeside and old-city venues price for visitors.
